parts.text: `gci` 顺着 `node_modules` 连接点遍历报错了，没拿到干净结果。改用 `-ErrorAction SilentlyContinue` 并把范围限定在 `dist`、排除 `node_modules` 重新核验。

tool_input.command:
$wt="D:\repository\门户\zhi2-web-admin-wt-chart-font-clarity"
$dist="$wt\dist"
Write-Host "dist exists:" (Test-Path $dist)
$files = gci $dist -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notlike '*\node_modules\*' }
Write-Host "dist file count (excl node_modules):" $files.Count
Write-Host "googleapis:" (($files | Select-String -Pattern "googleapis" -SimpleMatch).Count)
Write-Host "Noto Sans SC:" (($files | Select-String -Pattern "Noto Sans SC" -SimpleMatch).Count)
Write-Host "JetBrains Mono:" (($files | Select-String -Pattern "JetBrains Mono" -SimpleMatch).Count)
Write-Host "font-sans:system-ui in css:" (($files | Where-Object { $_.Extension -eq '.css' } | Select-String -Pattern "font-sans:system-ui").Count)
Write-Host "#334155 occurrences:" (($files | Select-String -Pattern "#334155" -SimpleMatch).Count)
